description: The donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different types of stimuli used in the context of generative AI’s application in journalism, as referenced in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into ten distinct segments, each labeled with a stimulus category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents “Press Release” at 18.7%, followed closely by “External News Article” in dark green at 18.1%. Other notable segments include “Interview” (8.8%, purple), “Organizational Report” (7.7%, light purple), and “Event Posting” (6.6%, maroon). Smaller segments include “Organizational Website” and “Intra-agency news article” (both 4.9%, light blue and navy respectively), “Email” (2.7%, light green), and “Social Media Post” (1.1%, yellow-orange). A grayed-out segment at the top right appears to be intentionally obscured or redacted. The chart uses a clean, color-coded legend-free design with labels placed directly adjacent to each slice, and the segments are arranged in a roughly descending order clockwise from the top. The central white space contains the bolded title “Stimulus Type,” emphasizing the chart’s focus on categorizing input sources for AI-assisted journalistic storytelling.
